hooks.command: osascript -e 'display notification "Claude needs input" with title "Claude Code" sound name "Ping"'

python3 -c "import json, sys; data=json.load(sys.stdin); path=data.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); sys.exit(2 if any(p in path for p in ['.env', 'package-lock.json', '.git/', 'supabase/migrations/']) else 0)"

echo '=== Git Status ===' && git status --short 2>/dev/null || echo 'Not a git repo'; echo ''; echo '=== CLAUDE.md ===' && cat CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null || echo 'No CLAUDE.md'; echo ''; echo '=== Open Issues ===' && gh issue list --limit 5 2>/dev/null || echo 'gh not available'
